shared.name: template-author
shared.description: Use when a creator is about to be dispatched and it is open whether an existing template type fits the capability's purpose. Read-only; never writes or authors.

shared.name: statusline-setup
shared.description: Configures the user's Claude Code status line setting.

shared.name: skill-author
shared.description: Use when one named skill must be built or fixed and its template type and tier are already resolved by template-author and blueprint-author. Not for an agent or a command; never spawns agents.

shared.name: general-purpose
shared.description: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks.

shared.name: dynamic-author
shared.description: Use when a skill, agent or command must be authored or refactored through the dynamic authoring pipeline, from the task payload of the dynamic authoring command. The only agent that delegates in that pipeline; it never writes.

shared.name: context-init
shared.description: Use when a project's context must be captured for one scope (frontend, backend, CMS, or a dev environment such as Docker, DDEV, devcontainer or CI); one spawn per scope, the scope named in the task payload. Read-only; never writes, decides or spawns.

shared.name: command-author
shared.description: Use when one named slash command must be built or fixed and its template type and tier are already resolved by template-author and blueprint-author. Not for a skill or an agent; never spawns agents.

shared.name: claude-config
shared.description: Resolves the Claude Code provider config for one capability: given its goal and resolved template type, returns the concrete entry for its <type>.claude.yaml (model, tools, skills, memory, allowed-tools, paths) with a one-line reason per field. Advisory and read-only: never writes files, never spawns agents, never authors the capability. Use after the tier decision, before a creator is dispatched.

shared.name: claude-code-guide
shared.description: Questions about Claude Code (the CLI tool), the Claude Agent SDK, the Claude API, Claude Tag (Claude in Slack), or the plugin eval framework.

shared.name: claude
shared.description: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed.

shared.name: capability-scout
shared.description: Use when a project needs to know which capabilities it is missing, or after its standing context (product, identity, architecture, memory) has changed. Read-only; never writes, registers, compiles or dispatches.

shared.name: blueprint-author
shared.description: Use when the template type of a capability is settled and its tier, placeholder contract and variable whitelist are still open. Read-only; never writes.

shared.name: agent-author
shared.description: Use when one named agent must be built or fixed and its template type and tier are already resolved by template-author and blueprint-author. Not for a skill or a command; never spawns agents.

shared.name: Plan
shared.description: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans.

shared.name: Explore
shared.description: Fast read-only search agent for locating code by pattern, symbol, or keyword.

shared.name: planner
shared.description: Use when a session needs a plan drafted from the ready backlog items assigned to it, with the session and those items in the task payload. Read-only; never writes, registers, compiles, dispatches or spawns agents; hands the draft back as its report.

shared.name: capability-reviewer
shared.description: Use when an authored skill, agent or command needs review before it lands, with its class, the files written and the author report in the task payload. Read-only; never writes, never runs a script that mutates the tree, never spawns agents.

shared.name: bash-reviewer
shared.description: Use when a bash change needs review before it lands: a commit, a range or named files (default the last commit). Read-only; never writes, never runs a script that mutates the tree, never spawns agents.

shared.name: bash-author
shared.description: Use when bash code must be written against a spec the caller already resolved (tier, files to write, behavior). Several may run in parallel on disjoint write lists. Never spawns agents, never decides tier or scope, does not review.
